classifications.evidence: I hereby prescribe the following amendment of the regulations

classifications.rationale: The President presently amends the regulation to impose a security-based condition on eligibility for merchant-vessel documentation and employment, while authorizing the Commandant to exempt vessel categories; the legal rule is established by this segment itself.
classifications.evidence: No person shall be issued a document required for employment on a merchant vessel of the United States nor shall any person be employed on a merchant vessel of the United States unless the Commandant is satisfied
